policy.automatic_asset_rule: Competition catalog AND personal catalog; instantiate using the personal launcher template.
policy.competition_only_rule: Exclude from personal automatic capture and list for separate competition-launcher manual capture.
policy.personal_only_rule: Exclude because the target competition launcher does not provide the asset.
policy.dataset_scope_exclusion_rule: Exclude Tree-prefixed assets regardless of launcher availability because trees are static map context and are outside the target OD actor catalog.
